description: Entered three paid and no name.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Guessed a country justice, and stopped the guess there.
name: John Heminges

description: Gave the account of the house, and took the fist for clapping.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Asked if the man clapped, and left the answer as it was.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Named the sixth time only after the play, and refused a patron made of a fist.
name: William Shakespeare
